use_case_name: Browse and Search Files and Archives

claims.content: Enable users to browse and search files/archives using keyboard shortcuts, menu options, and navigation tools

goal.raw_text: Enable users to browse and search files/archives using keyboard shortcuts, menu options, and navigation tools

claims.content: User
Application launched
File manager interface active
User has access permissions
User presses a keyboard shortcut (e.g., F2, F3, F6) or clicks the 'File' menu button to initiate browsing or searching within the file manager interface.

trigger.raw_text: User presses a keyboard shortcut (e.g., F2, F3, F6) or clicks the 'File' menu button to initiate browsing or searching within the file manager interface.

claims.content: User presses 'File' menu button to open submenu with browsing and access options.
User selects 'Filesystem' from the File menu to browse objects organized by functional hierarchy.
Alternatively, user may select 'Bookmarks', 'Recent archives', 'Open path', or 'Open archive' from the File menu for direct access to rated, recently browsed, or specific path/archive objects.
User navigates using navigation bar buttons (back, forward, up) and refresh button provided in file manager interface.
User toggles between browse mode and flat view mode by pressing F6 or * key.
User initiates search in current folder and subfolders by pressing F3, or searches only in current folder by pressing Ctrl+F3.
User may use other functional keys such as F2 (browse desktop/home/root), F4 (up one level), F5 (refresh), F7–F10 (recent items, bookmarks, password, menu) to enhance browsing efficiency.
If a keyboard shortcut is not supported for the current archive type, it will be ignored.
Files and archives have been browsed or searched according to user selection.
Search or browse results are displayed in the file manager interface.
Object selection is enabled for user interaction with displayed items.
Navigation state (current path, view mode, search context) is updated to reflect user actions.
